## Welcome

This deck is the shared sample used to preview Quarto's built-in
presentation formats.

- Plain bullet points with **bold** and *italics*
- [Links](https://quarto.org) and `inline code`
    - and nested bullets
- Columns, tables, callouts and maths

# Writing

## Two columns

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Left

- One source document
- Many output formats
- Version control friendly
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Right

- HTML slides via reveal.js
- PDF slides via Beamer
- PowerPoint, too
:::

::::

## Code runs where the prose lives

```python
import seaborn as sns

df = sns.load_dataset("penguins")
df.groupby("species").bill_length_mm.mean().round(1)
```

# Results

## Palmer penguins at a glance

| Species   | Count | Bill (mm) | Mass (g) |
|-----------|------:|----------:|---------:|
| Adelie    |   152 |      38.8 |    3,701 |
| Chinstrap |    68 |      48.8 |    3,733 |
| Gentoo    |   124 |      47.5 |    5,076 |

## Maths and callouts

The mean of $n$ observations is

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i
$$

::: {.callout-tip}
Callouts come in five flavours: note, tip, important, caution and warning.
:::
